mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_profile_features ( user_id, phone, nickname, agreement_id, apartment_id, room_id, lease_start_date, lease_end_date, lease_term_months, rent_amount, deposit_amount, payment_type_id, browse_cnt_30d, last_browse_time, appointment_cnt_30d, last_appointment_time, activity_level_tag, intention_tag, value_level_tag, payment_behavior_tag, data_date, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT u.id, u.phone, u.nickname, lc.agreement_id, lc.apartment_id, lc.room_id, lc.lease_start_date, lc.lease_end_date, lc.lease_term_months, lc.rent_amount, lc.deposit_amount, lc.payment_type_id, COALESCE(b.browse_cnt_30d, 0), b.last_browse_time, COALESCE(a.appointment_cnt_30d, 0), a.last_appointment_time, CASE WHEN COALESCE(b.browse_cnt_30d, 0) >= 5 THEN '高活跃' WHEN COALESCE(b.browse_cnt_30d, 0) BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '中活跃' ELSE '低活跃' END AS activity_level_tag, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.appointment_cnt_30d, 0) >= 2 THEN '高意向' WHEN COALESCE(a.appointment_cnt_30d, 0) = 1 THEN '中意向' ELSE '低意向' END AS intention_tag, CASE WHEN lc.rent_amount >= 4000 THEN '高价值' WHEN lc.rent_amount BETWEEN 2500 AND 3999 THEN '中价值' ELSE '低价值' END AS value_level_tag, '准时支付' AS payment_behavior_tag, #{dataDate}, NOW(), NOW() FROM user_info u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT la.phone, la.id AS agreement_id, la.apartment_id, la.room_id, la.lease_start_date, la.lease_end_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, la.lease_start_date, la.lease_end_date) AS lease_term_months, la.rent AS rent_amount, la.deposit AS deposit_amount, la.payment_type_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.phone ORDER BY la.lease_start_date DESC) AS rn FROM lease_agreement la WHERE la.is_deleted = 0 AND la.status IN (2, 5, 7) ) tmp_contract WHERE tmp_contract.rn = 1 ) lc ON lc.phone = u.phone LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bh.user_id, COUNT(*) AS browse_cnt_30d, MAX(bh.browse_time) AS last_browse_time FROM browsing_history bh WHERE bh.is_deleted = 0 AND bh.browse_time >= DATE_SUB(#{dataDate}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY bh.user_id ) b ON b.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.user_id, COUNT(*) AS appointment_cnt_30d, MAX(v.appointment_time) AS last_appointment_time FROM view_appointment v WHERE v.is_deleted = 0 AND v.appointment_time >= DATE_SUB(#{dataDate}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY v.user_id ) a ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE phone = VALUES(phone), nickname = VALUES(nickname), agreement_id = VALUES(agreement_id), apartment_id = VALUES(apartment_id), room_id = VALUES(room_id), lease_start_date = VALUES(lease_start_date), lease_end_date = VALUES(lease_end_date), lease_term_months = VALUES(lease_term_months), rent_amount = VALUES(rent_amount), deposit_amount = VALUES(deposit_amount), payment_type_id = VALUES(payment_type_id), browse_cnt_30d = VALUES(browse_cnt_30d), last_browse_time = VALUES(last_browse_time), appointment_cnt_30d = VALUES(appointment_cnt_30d), last_appointment_time = VALUES(last_appointment_time), activity_level_tag = VALUES(activity_level_tag), intention_tag = VALUES(intention_tag), value_level_tag = VALUES(value_level_tag), payment_behavior_tag = VALUES(payment_behavior_tag), data_date = VALUES(data_date), updated_at = NOW();
